survival.encounter.attendance.title: Marks on the class list
survival.encounter.attendance.text: The last person out circled a place on the register. An emergency pack remains under the lectern.
survival.encounter.evacuation_list.title: Two evacuation lists
survival.encounter.evacuation_list.text: Two lists give different assembly points. The desk register records when they were stamped.
survival.encounter.hidden_bite.option_1: Ask them to stay at the lounge
survival.encounter.hidden_bite.option_2: Escort them to the rest area
survival.encounter.hidden_bite.option_3: Stay together for the next stop
survival.encounter.hidden_bite.title: A hidden bite
survival.encounter.hidden_bite.text: A survivor stops and rubs their arm. A bite is visible under the slipping cuff.
survival.encounter.classroom_route.optio: Move the chair and split the water
survival.encounter.classroom_route.title: Across two classrooms
survival.encounter.classroom_route.text: A graduate student sketches the side corridor. Their dropped water is trapped under a chair.
survival.encounter.rearranged_desks.opti: Clear a path for the student
survival.encounter.rearranged_desks.text: A student is stranded behind stacked desks. Their bag lies under the closest desk.
survival.encounter.parcel_shift.option_2: Deliver the crate to the mailroom
survival.encounter.parcel_shift.title: One share only
survival.encounter.parcel_shift.text: A mail worker trades water for food, or offers a ration for moving a crate to the mailroom.
survival.encounter.open_locker.title: A jammed locker
survival.encounter.open_locker.text: A warped locker holds water near the top and an exit plan wedged below.
survival.encounter.marked_cases.option_1: Check the numbers and take food
survival.encounter.marked_cases.option_2: Escort the owner to return the case
survival.encounter.marked_cases.title: Swapped case numbers
survival.encounter.marked_cases.text: A student mixed up two labels. One case has supplies. The other has an owner waiting.
survival.encounter.spill_plan.option_1: Clear the corridor for a share of water
survival.encounter.spill_plan.title: Overturned buckets
survival.encounter.spill_plan.text: Overturned buckets block half the corridor. A student is ready to move them. Bottles are on a cart.
survival.encounter.trapped_stands.option: Make an opening with the bat
Circle the stands to reach them
survival.encounter.trapped_stands.title: Trapped in the stands
survival.encounter.trapped_stands.text: A survivor is trapped in the stands. Push the infected back or reach the survivor from the other side.
survival.encounter.cold_counter.option_2: Shift the freezer for the spare ration
survival.encounter.cold_counter.title: Food behind the freezer
survival.encounter.cold_counter.text: A ration is wedged behind a freezer. Someone needs water and won't leave their share unattended.
survival.encounter.shifts.title: Two watch lists
survival.encounter.shifts.text: Only two people still cover the lounge. One wants to leave; the other wants to track the last residents.
survival.encounter.bottles_bin.option_1: Sort the cart for the sealed bottle
survival.encounter.bottles_bin.option_2: Put the cart away and catch your breath
survival.encounter.bottles_bin.title: Empty bottles in a cart
survival.encounter.bottles_bin.text: Two bottles landed in the recycling cart. One sealed bottle may be buried at the bottom.
survival.encounter.rest_mat.option_1: Trade food for a place to rest
survival.encounter.rest_mat.title: The borrowed rest mat
survival.encounter.rest_mat.text: Someone has taken up the rest mats. A ration buys a seat, or you can clear another corner.
survival.encounter.missing_custodian.opt: Log and retrieve the unclaimed ration
survival.encounter.missing_custodian.tex: The supply keeper never returned. A record points to a destination, and a ration lies unclaimed further in.
survival.encounter.dispatch_copy.title: A dispatch stub
survival.encounter.dispatch_copy.text: An incomplete route stub remains in the ledger. A survivor wants help leaving safely.
survival.encounter.stuck_trolley.option_: Park it against the wall and rest
Pull the water out from underneath
survival.encounter.stuck_trolley.title: A jammed trolley
survival.encounter.stuck_trolley.text: A trolley is jammed between a bench and the aisle. Clear a resting place or search beneath it for water.
survival.encounter.index_cards.option_2: Leave food in exchange for water
survival.encounter.index_cards.title: Two sets of badges
survival.encounter.index_cards.text: A pile of badges records departures. Someone will trade water for portable food.
survival.encounter.stalls_cleanup.option: Lift the cart and claim a ration
Clear the aisle so the worker can exit
survival.encounter.stalls_cleanup.title: A trolley after closing
survival.encounter.stalls_cleanup.text: An overturned trolley pins a ration. A worker asks you to clear the scattered tables first.
survival.encounter.exhibit_record.option: Mark the turnaround on the map
Escort the reader from the building
survival.encounter.exhibit_record.title: Notes by the display
survival.encounter.exhibit_record.text: Someone sketched evacuation directions behind a display. A reader is waiting for others to see them.
survival.encounter.chair_path.option_1: Clear the chairs and retrieve food
survival.encounter.chair_path.option_2: Make time to rest in the classroom
survival.encounter.chair_path.title: A narrow classroom aisle
survival.encounter.chair_path.text: A backpack is trapped between overturned chairs. Someone nearby looks exhausted.
survival.encounter.return_lane.option_1: Mark the edge of the plaza
survival.encounter.return_lane.title: A sketch at the returns desk
survival.encounter.return_lane.text: A survivor marked a path at the returns desk and won't cross the plaza alone.
survival.encounter.roster_help.option_1: Copy the rendezvous from the slip
survival.encounter.roster_help.title: The last room slip
survival.encounter.roster_help.text: A resident wrote an assembly point on a room slip. Another offers food in exchange for water.
survival.encounter.window_manifest.title: The mail dispatch sheet
survival.encounter.window_manifest.text: An unsigned delivery lists a drop-off. The worker wants to finish the handover.
survival.encounter.team_bench.title: At the team bench
survival.encounter.team_bench.text: Someone lined up the team bags. There's time to rest or check a communal supply bag.
survival.encounter.lawn_split.option_2: Walk the perimeter with the cautious survivor
survival.encounter.lawn_split.title: Two separated survivors
survival.encounter.lawn_split.text: Two people disagree on the escape. One wants the open lawn, the other wants the perimeter.
survival.encounter.stairs_trade.title: Receipts by the stairs
survival.encounter.stairs_trade.text: Someone logged which supplies people reclaimed. They can swap water or need help reaching open ground.
survival.encounter.lake_detour.option_1: Mark a way around the outer shore
survival.encounter.lake_detour.option_2: Pull the abandoned luggage off the steps
survival.encounter.lake_detour.title: Turnaround by the lake
survival.encounter.lake_detour.text: Only one survivor here still wants to move. A sealed bottle remains in luggage by the steps.
survival.encounter.gate_partner.option_1: Recruit her to cross the north plaza
survival.encounter.gate_partner.option_2: Mark her route at the next junction
survival.encounter.gate_partner.title: The one turning back
survival.encounter.gate_partner.text: A person returning from the gate knows two junctions. She wants company or can only point the way.
survival.encounter.clock_roll.option_1: Add the assembly sketch to the map
survival.encounter.clock_roll.option_2: Invite him away from the assembly area
survival.encounter.clock_roll.title: Waiting by the clock
survival.encounter.clock_roll.text: A person at the clock drew an assembly sketch and will only wait until the hour.
survival.encounter.dorm_sack.option_1: Unload the heavy boxes for food
survival.encounter.dorm_sack.option_2: Take a breather off the path
survival.encounter.dorm_sack.title: The weight on the trolley
survival.encounter.dorm_sack.text: Someone is dragging a broken dorm trolley. Helping clear it earns a ration, or you can recover nearby.
survival.encounter.puddle_pack.option_1: Take the stone steps to get the bag
survival.encounter.puddle_pack.option_2: Cross the puddle to drag the bag out
survival.encounter.puddle_pack.title: The bag at the puddle
survival.encounter.puddle_pack.text: A bag with water fell into a puddle. Solid ground takes longer, or you can step across with effort.
survival.encounter.sport_path.option_1: Mark the way toward the ball field
survival.encounter.sport_path.option_2: Move the seat and retrieve water
survival.encounter.sport_path.title: Across the sports grounds
survival.encounter.sport_path.text: A runner knows the open paths. Unclaimed water is trapped below the rest seats.
survival.encounter.road_hold.option_2: Let them join and continue together
survival.encounter.road_hold.title: A survivor at the fork
survival.encounter.road_hold.text: Someone waits at the fork for a slower companion. They can mark the path, or ask you to stay with them.
survival.encounter.campus_rain.option_1: Rest at the edge of the plaza
survival.encounter.campus_rain.option_2: Cross and mark an alternate route
survival.encounter.campus_rain.title: A sudden downpour
survival.encounter.campus_rain.text: Rain fills the low footpath. You can take a breather or push through with effort.
survival.encounter.service_load.option_1: Help haul back the crate for water
survival.encounter.service_load.title: A dropped crate
survival.encounter.service_load.text: A crate of water slid toward the railing. Help retrieve it or ask the worker for a route.
survival.encounter.plaza_exchange.option: Trade a bottle of water for food
Move the bench and mark the detour
survival.encounter.plaza_exchange.title: A swap on the plaza
survival.encounter.plaza_exchange.text: A survivor keeps food and water in separate bags and will only trade. The detour requires clearing a bench.
survival.encounter.shore_wait.option_1: Check the list and take the spare ration
survival.encounter.shore_wait.option_2: Mark the rendezvous on the list
survival.encounter.shore_wait.title: A list on the steps
survival.encounter.shore_wait.text: A luggage list and an unclaimed ration lie on the steps. The listed rendezvous can be mapped.
survival.encounter.south_note.option_2: Let them pack and join you
survival.encounter.south_note.title: A handover at the junction
survival.encounter.south_note.text: Someone is waiting for an absent shift. They need help moving supplies or will leave with you.
survival.encounter.split_track.option_1: Escort him out of this stretch
survival.encounter.split_track.title: A roommate separated
survival.encounter.split_track.text: A resident lost their roommate. They can point out a longer route or ask for an escort.
survival.encounter.white_fabric.option_1: Verify and mark the posted route
survival.encounter.white_fabric.option_2: Clear a spot to regain stamina
survival.encounter.white_fabric.title: Fabric on a bench
survival.encounter.white_fabric.text: Fabric marks a passable route beside a written record. There is room to clear a place to rest.
survival.ui.controls: Shift to run · 1–5 to select gear
survival.gear_tip.key: Reusable for locked buildings and bikes
survival.gear_tip.bat: Space · swing the bat · uses stamina
survival.event.key_ready: Press E next to a locked building or bike.
survival.event.need_key: Locked. Search an unlocked building or stagger an infected person to find a key.
survival.event.door_blocked: An infected person is blocking this entrance.
survival.event.too_tired: Too tired. Walk or stop to recover stamina.
survival.event.throw_warning: An infected person raises an object to throw.
survival.event.throw_hit: The debris struck you. You can still move.
survival.event.throw_injury: The debris injured you. Your speed is temporarily reduced.
survival.event.throw_infected: Contamination reached your wound. The infection is spreading.
survival.event.infection_started: You were bitten. Your legs are giving way.
survival.event.hidden_reveal: An infected person rises from concealment.
survival.event.wait_for_person: Wait for the other person to reach the marker.
survival.event.stun_guard_first: Stagger the infected at the stands before helping the survivor.
survival.event.traded: You traded a ration for water.
survival.fixture.task_parcel: Deliver the crate to the mailroom
survival.fixture.task_rescue_bat: Help the survivor while the infected staggers
survival.fixture.task_rescue_detour: Reach the survivor from this side
survival.route.wait: The gate notice mentions emergency assembly sites. Search a nearby unlocked building for supplies and a key.
survival.route.lock_log.text: The register shows arrivals but no departures. The attendant marked {place}. An unopened bottle remains under the desk.
survival.read.clerk: I have water, but I haven't eaten. Trade a ration for it, or share water and I'll leave with you.
survival.read.bitten: A bite shows under the cuff. Their steps are already unsteady.
survival.exp.result.exchange_food: You exchanged a bottle of water for a ration.
survival.exp.result.rest_traded: You gave up a ration and recovered stamina by sitting down.
survival.exp.result.route_marked: A blue waypoint now appears on the map.
survival.exp.result.work_water: You spent some time and added water to your pack.
survival.exp.result.work_food: You completed the work and received a ration.
survival.exp.result.rested: You caught your breath and recovered stamina.
survival.exp.result.evacuated: You cleared the way, and the survivor left on their own.
survival.exp.result.task_parcel: Carrying the box slows you down. Deliver it to the blue marker to earn the ration. G puts it down.
survival.exp.result.parcel_delivered: The crate reached the mailroom. You received the promised ration.
survival.exp.result.task_right_list: The blue waypoint marks the assembly point to verify.
survival.exp.result.task_wrong_list: The closest listed site is marked on the map. Verify it when you get there.
survival.exp.result.list_wrong: The times don't match here. The other site is now marked on the map.
survival.exp.result.list_confirmed: The local record confirms the evacuation list.
survival.exp.result.task_lawn: Bring the survivor to the blue waypoint. Don't leave them behind.
survival.exp.result.lawn_done: You reached the marker together. The survivor will stay with you.
survival.exp.result.lawn_safe: The survivor stays with you and marks a detour for the next stretch.
survival.exp.result.task_rescue_bat: Reach the blue marker. Stagger the infected, then help the survivor right away.
survival.exp.result.task_rescue_detour: Circle to the other blue marker before the survivor is caught.
survival.exp.result.rescue_done: You got the survivor down from the stands. They joined your group.
survival.exp.result.task_care: Reach the blue rest point before the infection progresses.
survival.exp.result.bite_left: They stayed in the lounge. You have one less companion.
survival.exp.result.bite_settled: They gave you the dorm rendezvous. It's marked on your map.
survival.exp.result.bite_risk: They keep following. The infection is still spreading.
survival.exp.result.task_outdoor_escort: Reach the blue junction marker together.
survival.exp.result.task_missed: It's too late to complete this objective.
survival.exp.result.escort_complete: You escorted the survivor to a safer place.
survival.event.parcel_dropped: You put down the crate. Return to the blue marker to pick it up.
survival.event.contamination: The infection spread. This run is over.
survival.death.contamination: Contamination entered the wound. You lose your balance and collapse.
survival.exp.result.exchange_water: You exchanged a ration for a bottle of water.
